section: Abstract, sentence 1
source_basis: This paper addresses the problem of scheduling the maximum number of rafting trips along the Big Long River.
interpretation: Open by naming the decision object and its scale before any method. Transfer the move, not the river or campsite facts.
applicability: This paper addresses the problem of {object}
counterevidence: Do not open with industry background before naming the object.

section: Abstract, sentence 2
source_basis: An optimal schedule for this problem would minimize the number of crossovers while maximizing the percentage of campsites used and matching a target distribution of trip lengths.
interpretation: Define the objective as a three-way trade-off rather than a single maximum. Transfer the move, not the river or campsite facts.
applicability: An optimal {object} would {criterion one} while {criterion two} and {criterion three}
counterevidence: Do not present a single-objective optimum when the problem has competing criteria.

section: Abstract, sentence 3
